name: pi-tool-display
notes: Forked from MasuRii/pi-tool-display; local bashLivePreviewMode (tail live preview for running bash commands) feature intentionally diverges from upstream. The fork also adds a kind:'bash' tool-display adapter so pi-sandbox's decorated bash tool renders natively (renderBashDisplayResult extracted in tool-overrides.ts, serving both the built-in override path and the adapter; the promptGuidelines-copying registration-test assertions match upstream createBuiltinToolDisplay behavior), plus type-publishing build (rollup.dts.config.mjs, exports types -> dist/public.d.ts via prepack). 2026-09-19: tail/head preview unified — upstream formatTruncationHint gained an optional label param and buildPreviewText an optional take:'head'|'tail' param (defaults keep upstream behavior byte-stable); the fork-only formatEarlierLinesHint/buildTailPreviewText copies were removed and the unreachable empty-lines branch dropped. 2026-09-27: added fork-only bashOutputMode:'auto' (live tail preview while running, line-count summary after success; errors keep opencode rendering) in fork-only src/bash-auto-mode.ts (resolveBashAutoOutputMode normalizer). Upstream seams: one import of that module in tool-overrides.ts, one normalization call at the top of the fork-owned renderBashDisplayResult before the partial/error branches, types.ts BASH_OUTPUT_MODES gains 'auto', config-modal.ts bashOutputMode values+inspectorOptions and bashCollapsedLines summary/advanced wording, README mode/config rows + live-preview paragraph. Fork-only tests/bash-auto-mode.test.ts covers it (re-audit all of these after each sync). Same change restored 4 pre-existing whitespace-only README table-separator rows to upstream bytes, so raw numstat equals -w for every touched upstream file. Deliberate non-change: package-lock.json keeps upstream bytes at the upstream version 0.5.0 across fork releases — it is unconsumed in this pnpm monorepo and npm excludes it from tarballs; do not hand-edit it, keep upstream bytes on syncs. 2026-09-28: added fork-only bashCommandDisplay ('full'|'collapsed'|'auto', default 'full') — the bash tool-call command line is folded onto one display line and ANSI-clamped to the terminal width (process.stdout.columns, 120-column fallback) when collapsed; expanded rows always render the original multi-line command, and 'auto' is full while executionStarted && isPartial and collapsed after completion (including errors). New fork-only module src/bash-command-display.ts (BASH_COMMAND_FALLBACK_WIDTH, BASH_COMMAND_ELLIPSIS, resolveBashCommandDisplayWidth(renderWidth?) — render width, then process.stdout.columns, then the documented 120-column fallback, shouldCollapseBashCommand, foldBashCommandToSingleLine, clampBashCommandLineToWidth, resolveBashCommandDisplayArgs, and the BashCommandLineText Text subclass that clamps at render(width) so the line fits the message box rather than only the terminal) plus fork-only tests/bash-command-display.test.ts (18 tests: config normalization, fold/clamp/width units, full/collapsed/auto rendering, render-width clamping, expanded override, component reuse, config summary, settings-inspector item). Upstream seams: src/bash-display.ts (fork import block; renderBashCall gains an optional config param, replaces upstream's `new Text("", 0, 0)` reuse expression with `new BashCommandLineText("", 0, 0)`, and adds one resolveBashCommandDisplayArgs(args, config, context) preprocessing line plus one text.setCollapse(shouldCollapseBashCommand(config, context)) line; buildBashCallText and its 3 call sites keep upstream bytes); src/tool-overrides.ts (2 renderBashCall call sites pass the existing getConfig()); src/types.ts (BASH_COMMAND_DISPLAY_MODES + BashCommandDisplay type + ToolDisplayConfig field + default 'full'); src/config-store.ts (toBashCommandDisplay converter + normalize field); src/config-modal.ts (summary 'bashCommand=' part, bashCommandDisplay inspector item, applySetting case); src/presets.ts (configsEqual compares bashCommandDisplay; preset configs keep the 'full' default so no preset behavior changes); README.md (config-table row + 'Bash Command Line Display' section + example-config key); config/config.example.json. Re-audit all of these after each sync; raw numstat equals -w numstat for every touched upstream file. packages/pi-tool-display/config.json is gitignored local dev config, not a subtree file.
